request.deadline: 12-month grant period beginning after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Part-time maintainer for Dolos over 12 months
Dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback-driven enhancements, and public developer communication
Milestone-based disbursement controls through Intersect-managed smart contracts
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address for administration on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: maintaining Cardano's lightweight data node for Year 2 over 12 months, including maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for Dolos maintenance, with a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee for a total withdrawal of 540,750 ADA.

Dolos is described as a Rust-based lightweight Cardano data node that connects to the Cardano network, indexes ledger primitives, and exposes multiple query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C socket.
The proposal states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope includes code maintenance, protocol compatibility, performance work, bug fixes, documentation, community support, contribution review, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal asserts Dolos provides an open-source alternative for querying Cardano chain data without running a full node and supports developer and infrastructure operator needs.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as included through Intersect administration and third-party oversight.

The proposal discloses that TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

The proposal says Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, oversight entities, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA to fund 12 months of Dolos maintenance through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, presenting Dolos as open-source Cardano infrastructure with claimed adoption metrics, prior delivery history, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
